core_obligations: Reduce to the case M = A/q of dimension one, then to A a one-dimensional local Noetherian domain, and finally to the case where both a and b lie in the maximal ideal (proof lines 17672-17691).

Choose the extension A subset A' with a = t a', b = t b' and rewrite the relation in terms of the relative symbols d^A_{A'}, using the multiplicativity and comparison lemmas (proof lines 17693-17730).

Evaluate the relative symbols through the three displayed decompositions of A'/(a'(b' - a')), A'/(b'(b' - a')) and A'/(a'b') as products of cyclic modules, track the sign from multiplication by b' - a', and conclude with the sign computation for d^A_{A'}(b', b') (proof lines 17732-17758).
proof_roadmap: Three reductions: to a cyclic module, to a one-dimensional domain, and to both elements in the maximal ideal (proof lines 17672-17691).
Pass to the two-element factorization and rewrite in relative symbols (proof lines 17693-17730).
Compute the relative symbols from the cyclic decompositions (proof lines 17732-17752).
Track the sign and apply the periodic determinant sign lemma (proof lines 17754-17758).
difficulty_reason: For a Noetherian local ring A, elements a, b and a finite A-module M of dimension one on which a, b and b - a are nonzerodivisors, the lemma asserts the relation d_M(a, b - a) d_M(b, b) = d_M(b, b - a) d_M(a, b) in kappa^* (statement lines 17659-17670). The proof reduces in three stages: by Lemma labelled lemma-compute-symbol-M it suffices to treat M = A/q of dimension one (proof lines 17672-17675); then A may be replaced by A/q because the determinants over A and over A/q are canonically identified by Lemma labelled lemma-determinant-quotient-ring, so A may be taken to be a one-dimensional local Noetherian domain (proof lines 17677-17685); and the cases where a or b is a unit are dispatched by Lemma labelled lemma-symbol-when-one-is-a-unit and Lemma labelled lemma-symbol-when-equal, so both may be assumed to lie in the maximal ideal (proof lines 17687-17691). The core then chooses the extension A subset A' together with the factorizations a = t a', b = t b' supplied by Lemma labelled lemma-Noetherian-domain-dim-1-two-elements, works with the relative symbols d^A_{A'}(-,-) of Lemma labelled lemma-pre-symbol, relates them to the absolute symbols by Lemma labelled lemma-symbol-compare-modules, and evaluates them using the decompositions of A'/(a'(b' - a')), A'/(b'(b' - a')) and A'/(a'b') as products of cyclic modules together with Lemma labelled lemma-periodic-determinant-easy-case and Lemma labelled lemma-periodic-determinant (proof lines 17693-17752). Carrying the sign (-1)^{length_A(A'/(b'))} produced by the identification of multiplication by b' - a' with multiplication by minus a' and closing with Lemma labelled lemma-periodic-determinant-sign is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
